import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from ydata_profiling import ProfileReport

dates = pd.date_range("2023-01-01", periods=100, freq="D")
df = pd.DataFrame({"date": dates, "value": np.sin(np.arange(100))})

profile = ProfileReport(df, tsmode=True, sortby="date")
html = profile.to_html()
print("HTML length:", len(html))
print("HTML type:", type(html))

desc = profile.description_set

# time_index_analysis
tia = desc.time_index_analysis
print("\n=== time_index_analysis ===")
print("repr:", repr(tia))
if tia is not None:
    print("attrs:", {k: v for k, v in vars(tia).items()} if hasattr(tia, "__dict__") else tia)

# variable types
print("\n=== variable types ===")
for name, v in desc.variables.items():
    print(name, "->", v.get("type"))

print("\n=== value summary keys ===")
v = desc.variables["value"]
for k in sorted(v.keys()):
    print("  ", k, "=", repr(v[k])[:120])

print("\n=== targeted key checks ===")
for key in ["acf", "pacf", "seasonal", "seasonality_presence", "stationary", "addfuller", "is_stationary", "series"]:
    print(f"  {key}: present={key in v}", repr(v.get(key))[:100])

print("\nTIMESERIES in html:", "Time Series" in html or "TimeSeries" in html)
print("ACF/PACF in html:", "ACF" in html, "PACF" in html)
